result.summary: Wrote lit.md answering the 4 literature topics from analysis.md §5 (MAX/idiosyncratic-vol running-max structure; volume- vs equal-weighted intraday realized volatility; VWAP/money-weighted intraday return extremes; price-limit/board/listing-age mechanics), using WebSearch/WebFetch restricted to pre-2023-08-08 sources. Each citation has title/authors/year/source/link/verified flag; gaps (no literature found on the ~100-150 trading day lookback, no precedent for a multi-month max of money-weighted return, unidentified ChiNext natural-experiment paper) are stated explicitly rather than filled in. Key flags for the PI: (1) extreme-value vs volatility-level statistics are independent in both US and China literature, but no paper tests our specific 100-150 day window; (2) volume-weighted realized vol may load on continuous/activity variance rather than tail/jump risk, reinforcing the project's own planned ts_max-vs-ts_mean diagnostic; (3) head2's sign matches the classic short-horizon order-imbalance reversal effect with no literature precedent for stretching it to a multi-month extremum, a risk flag rather than support.
